sources.title: Rookie WR Germie Bernard: Aaron Rodgers pouring as much into me as he can
sources.description: Aaron Rodgers is planning for the 2026 season to be his final one as an NFL player, but the Steelers could continue to benefit from his experience after he officially hangs up the cleats.
